scope: Reuse saved scoped conclusions and audited completed evidence; no paper reread credit or new experiment

families.prior_boundary: BatchEnsemble already supplies rank-one member factors on shared weights; TabM supplies deliberate initialization, member losses and ensemble-aware selection. Kim (2023) applies BatchEnsemble inside GNN layers. Boundary-only factors and raw-logit pooling are configuration differences, not a new ensemble principle.
families.current_evidence: Original five-graph complete-method benchmark is intact. In the complete 36-fit Citeseer-HeaRT development family, unchanged shared F4 has mean VALID MRR 28.4115%, independent four 27.9204%, native single 26.7811%. Every primary descriptive interval includes zero.
families.decision: Retain as a competent base and comparator, not a proved new contribution. Sharing has an encouraging local development signal, not confirmed general superiority.
families.next_decisive_comparison: The unchanged F4 reference versus the frozen new training rule, capable same-rule single and true independently trained four; a positive screen must later transfer to fresh tasks under prospectively fixed choices.

families.prior_boundary: GNCL/SEA already trade member competence against ensemble error; DICE uses class-conditioned redundancy control; FoRDE uses input-gradient particle repulsion. Orthogonality or embedding distance alone can leave served logits unchanged or harm accuracy. Graph weighting does not make repulsion a new principle.
families.current_evidence: Saved objective/source analyses and FoRDE derivative fixtures establish bounded algebra or implementation properties. They establish no predictive superiority. The saved common-reference advantage rule cancels exactly in row-normalized softmax/loss allocation.
families.decision: Keep competence-anchored functional mechanisms as attributed hypotheses; reject the algebraically redundant common-reference allocation. Do not treat a resource or implementation failure as scientific falsification. Do not infer useful diversity from spread.
families.next_decisive_comparison: If reconsidered after current pilots, use competent ordinary training plus source-faithful declared DICE/FoRDE adaptations and a same-budget new functional rule; require better served accuracy/ranking and retained member competence rather than a diversity surrogate.

families.prior_boundary: AM-GCN already shares a Common-GCN across topology and feature graphs and combines common/private capacity. CAMERO learns shared representations from perturbed members. DIVE already learns graph-mask diversity; its private encoders/single serving differ from a tied uniform-pool construction.
families.current_evidence: Saved priors define a specific tying contrast. The native all-TRAIN controls and completed paired family are necessary before an outcome is attributed to sharing. This synthesis opens no pending predictions or partial scores.
families.decision: Retain as an unresolved sharing-quality hypothesis. Semantic edge deletion and trajectory persistence may help, but can remove valid heterophilous or boundary evidence.
families.next_decisive_comparison: Tied versus untied persistent members with identical graph views, labels and serving; semantic versus matched random deletion; persistent versus balanced shuffled exposure. If positive, compare a shared encoder with private heads to test whether separate propagation paths are needed.

families.prior_boundary: PreGS transfers supervised graph weights to heterogeneous experts and learns feature/logit fusion. HGEN/LHGEL already combine typed/meta-path graph views, multiple predictors, residual attention and correlation losses. OMoE supplies orthogonal expert responses and a router. A graph MoE or learned average is not new by itself.
families.current_evidence: Saved methods and source scopes identify direct ancestry. No audited result in this synthesis establishes a new graph router beating a capable single and true independent ensemble. Heterogeneous implementation/resource failures do not reject the general hypothesis.
families.decision: Retain only a task-specific residual or relation-mixing question with an explicit failure mechanism. Do not restart generic expert routing under a new name.
families.next_decisive_comparison: A prospective heterogeneous task with genuinely conflicting relation evidence: strongest single relation-aware backbone, independent ensemble, attributed native fusion, then a parameter-matched shared/private intervention. Require gains beyond ordinary fusion and confirm that relation-specific predictions carry useful residual evidence.

families.prior_boundary: PCGrad alters conflicting task gradients; OGD protects prior-output responses locally; collaborative and peer learning already route losses through different blocks. Negative gradient dots alone do not diagnose harmful sharing, especially under stateful Adam or coordinate changes.
families.current_evidence: Saved source analyses specify response-projection and mixed-loss candidates. They do not establish that protected responses improve predictive quality. Some loss-allocation claims reduce to known joint-training objectives.
families.decision: Keep only a measurable finite-update failure hypothesis: a shared step damages a competent member correction that the pooled predictor needs. Geometric feasibility or local invariance is insufficient.
families.next_decisive_comparison: At matched optimizer state/budget, compare ordinary shared update, an attributed PCGrad control and the specific response-preserving update, with a simple same-capacity private-block model. Require the preserved response to improve held-out served decisions; otherwise the constraint protects an unhelpful direction.

families.family: Private graph completion and joint structural evidence
families.prior_boundary: NCNC, learned residual-neighbor completion, CORE and Bayesian topology marginalization already associate graph uncertainty/completion with prediction. A joint two-edge probability cannot be recovered merely by changing marginal edge scores. Shared structural banks do not themselves create a new generative model.
families.current_evidence: The complete five-seed Collab TEST family gives private completion 67.2909% Hits@50, independent four 67.6298%, native single 66.4426%. The private-versus-pooled +0.2236-point contrast is inconclusive. Current conditional-pattern Collab/DDI work has no opened full-cohort quality result in this synthesis.
families.decision: The tested completion recipe does not beat the independent ensemble and is not promoted as a breakthrough. Retain joint evidence only where the joint term is identifiable and the current marginal model demonstrably discards relevant structure.
families.next_decisive_comparison: Complete the already frozen conditional-pattern families against their native single/joint controls and independent ensemble. Any new joint model needs equal-capacity marginal and interaction-removed controls on a fresh confirmation task, plus a strong native link predictor; consumed Collab TEST cannot become unseen confirmation.

families.prior_boundary: How to Train a Shallow Ensemble already studies centered, curvature-aware private-head initialization and covariance orientation on a shared backbone. Graph filters, residual transport, VJP directions and finite-step/bilevel selection have retained ancestry. Mean preservation or greater variance is not novelty.
families.current_evidence: Saved graph-conditioned selector/source analyses define an initialization candidate. Earlier warm-state reconstruction and preprocessing identity failures limit execution custody; no audited predictive continuation supports its quality claim here.
families.decision: Retain a graph-restricted search-space hypothesis; do not discard it merely for resource scarcity. It is currently below the qualified private-learning pilot in priority because both predictive utility and execution closure remain unresolved.
families.next_decisive_comparison: After exact native state reconstruction, compare selected graph-error directions with equal-rank random, permuted-graph, raw-gradient and curvature-based directions from the same warm state; retain competent single/independent controls and report native later quality, not the discarded TRAIN trial alone.

families.family: Private learning credit on endpoint-conditioned episodes
families.prior_boundary: ANIL/BMAML already train shared features through private adaptation. MLDG/MetaReg and Episodic DG establish training-only transfer and persistent private partners; Meta-Graph/H-GRAM/Meta-iKG establish graph episodes, including one-graph tasks. SELAR precedes virtual/meta/recomputed commitment. The remaining exact endpoint-union configuration has no global novelty clearance.
families.current_evidence: FP32/native-Adam implementation and state checks passed. The fixed 30-fit family has launched control-first; no new candidate accuracy result is available at the bound 05:55:09 UTC observation. The previous private-frame candidate failed improvement over unchanged F4 and remains unpromoted.
families.decision: Current first priority: a falsifiable test of shared representation quality after private learning, without embedding-repulsion assumptions. It remains an unproved graph meta-regularization recipe, not an established new method. The fixed outer competence term adds a nonnegative raw-logit Jensen gap, not forced error diversity.
families.next_decisive_comparison: Finish the unchanged frozen family. Compare endpoint live/detached and random live/detached, capable adapted single, paid single, untied same-rule four, ordinary joint four, unchanged F4 and preserved true independent four. Existing endpoint × live-credit interaction distinguishes generic meta-regularization from endpoint-specific credit. A lead still requires fresh confirmation.

fixed_outer_objective_interpretation.identity: 0.5*BCE(mean logits)+0.5*mean member BCE = BCE(mean logits)+0.5*nonnegative Jensen gap
